metadata.name: GetRewardSummary
metadata.description: The purpose of this API is to get the summary of rewards points which get  accumulated/expired/forfeited for the Account.

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source of API Consumer For external system expected sources will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of Client / Application Hosting Server Example: 10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: DateFormat
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Values are: 1 : MM/dd/yyyy HH:MM:SS (Default) 2 : MM/dd/yy HH:MM:SS 3 : dd/MM/yyyy HH:MM:SS Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: CurrencyCode
request_fields.description: Currency Code Place Holder for Future Use. Valid Values: Refer Appendix Section - Currency Code Example:840 = US Dollar Condition:If no value is passed, default value = 840 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CurrencySymbolType
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. CurrencySymbolType: 1: Currency Sign like $ 2: 3 ALPHA Currency Code like USD Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Language: en: means use English Default: en - English Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: ExternalIP
request_fields.description: IP Address of end user of API Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Session identifier of the API Example: 000028;026;1349906692 Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked. Example: 2.0 API Version Current Version 2.0 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller ID of source from where API is initiated it is End User Caller ID Example: 7204454214 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called ID of destination for which API is initiated It is Destination Called ID Example: 7314145404 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: RequestTime
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss Example:01/15/2020 10:05:23

request_fields.name: AccountNumber
request_fields.description: Account number of cardholder. Valid Values:0-9 Example:8000000000000037 Condition:At least one of AdminNumber/AccountNumber is required. Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: AdminNumber
request_fields.description: Details can be obtained by admin number  (Embossing Account id) Valid Values:0-9 Example:82432455 Condition:At least one of AdminNumber/AccountNumber is required.

response_fields.name: Status
response_fields.description: API Status Example: Success - true, Error - false

response_fields.name: ErrorCode
response_fields.description: Response Message Error Code Allowable Values: 10

children.name: Year
children.description: Year for reward details is listed. Valid Values:2020, 1990 Example: 0

children.name: LoyaltyPointsEarned
children.description: Total loyalty points earned on the Account. Valid Values:0-9 Format: XXX.XX Example:250

children.name: LoyaltyAmount
children.description: Amount equivalent to total points earned in the Year. Valid Values:  0-9 Format: $XX.XX Example: $20.00

children.name: LoyaltyProgramID
children.description: ID of Loyalty Program. Valid Values:0-9 Example:2345( Value shared by Corecard).

children.name: LoyaltyProgramName
children.description: Name of Loyalty Program. Example : Card Loyalty Program

children.name: LoyaltyAmountEarned
children.description: Amount equivalent to reward points earned on the Account. Valid Values:0-9 Example:250.50

children.name: LoyaltyAmountRedeemed
children.description: Amount equivalent to reward points which got redeemed. Valid Values:0-9 Example:250.50

children.name: LoyaltyPointsExpired
children.description: Total loyalty points which got expired as never redeemed. Valid Values:0-9 Example:90.00

children.name: LoyaltyPointsForfeited
children.description: Total loyalty points which got deleted for the account(It may be happened due to bad status of Account). Valid Values:0-9 Example:90.00

children.name: LoyaltyPointsRecovered
children.description: Loyalty Points which got recovered on the account. Valid Values:0-9 Example:50

children.name: LoyaltyPointsAbandoned
children.description: Loyalty Points which expired and never redeemed. Valid Values:0-9 Example:50

children.name: PendingRedeemPoints
children.description: Loyalty points which are parked to redeem but yet not redeemed. Valid Values:0-9 Example:50

children.name: ApprovedRedeemPoints
children.description: Approved Reward points Redeemed in statement cycle. Valid Values:0-9 Example:50.00

children.name: BeginningLoyaltyBalance
children.description: Loyalty Amount Balance at start of the month. Valid Values:0-9 Example:250.20

children.name: RemainingLoyaltyBalance
children.description: Remaining loyalty Amount which a customer can redeem. Valid Values:0-9 Example:250.20

children.name: MinimumDisbursment
children.description: Disbursement Minimum Amount as applicable on Loyalty Program Valid Values:0-9 Example: 0.01

children.name: LoyaltyProgramCount
children.description: Provide count of Loyalty Programs listed in the Array. Valid Values:  0-9 Format: XX Example:2
